snippet.title: We Pretend — Demo Trailer | PS1 Psychological Horror Game
snippet.description:
Enter a disturbing world of memories, emotions and psychological horror in We Pretend.

Inspired by the unsettling atmosphere and visuals of classic PS1-era horror games, We Pretend explores memories that may become increasingly dangerous as you uncover the emotions hidden within them.

The free demo is available now on Steam.

🎮 Try We Pretend and add the full game to your wishlist!
